refine_translation_lk — 3D refine op

• Data kinds: voxel × voxel × position → position

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.refine_translation_lk(scene, template, init_pos, device='cpu', iters=30, tol=0.0001) (to call the implementation directly, import match3d; match3d.refine_translation_lk(scene, template, init_pos, device='cpu', iters=30, tol=0.0001); from the registry, ops3d.get("refine_translation_lk"))

• GPU: this op has a GPU path (device="cuda")

Usage

Sub-voxel refinement of the 3-D translation by inverse-compositional Lucas-Kanade with Gauss-Newton.

Starting from the integer initial position init_pos given by a coarse match (integer NCC / Fourier-Mellin / Hough), minimises the SSD Σ|I(x+p) − T(x)|² and converges to the sub-voxel translation p.

Being inverse-compositional (Baker–Matthews), the steepest-descent image SD = ∇T and the Hessian H = Σ SDᵀSD are precomputed only once before iterating, and each iteration is only "trilinear warp of the scene + residual + 3×3 linear solve Δp = H⁻¹ Σ SDᵀ(I(x+p)−T)". The translation composition is p ← p − Δp. For a pure translation warp ∂W/∂p=I, so SD=∇T can be used as is.

Coordinate system: both init_pos and the return value are where the template origin (corner, index 0,0,0) lands in the scene as (dz,dy,dx). Matches the corner convention of sobel3d / grid_sample (note it differs from the centre convention of NCC (ncc_locate_3d) by T//2).

Parameters

scene : (D,H,W) array_like

Volume to search.

template : (Td,Th,Tw) array_like

Template to register (smaller than the scene).

init_pos : (3,) sequence

Integer initial position (dz,dy,dx) = scene coordinates of the template origin.

device : str

"cpu" / "cuda" etc. Device-independent.

iters : int

Maximum number of iterations.

tol : float

Stop as converged when ‖Δp‖ falls below this value.

Returns

pos : (3,) np.ndarray (float64)

Refined sub-voxel position (dz,dy,dx).

Notes

• Assumes a smooth (band-limited) density field. If the integer initial value is within ±0.5 to 1 voxel of the ground truth, usually 5 to 8 iterations give ‖err‖ < 0.05 voxel (at low noise). Measured (independent cubic-spline GT):

noise-free mean 0.008 / max 0.013 voxel (≈6 iterations, ≈1.2ms per call), about 60× better than the NCC sub-voxel

baseline (mean 0.56 voxel).

• grad_scale=32 is the fixed scale of the separable sobel3d (derivative [-1,0,1] × smoothing [1,2,1]²) (measured 32.0 on a linear ramp). It normalises to the true gradient and corrects the scale of Δp.

• A small Levenberg regularisation is added to H to prevent numerical breakdown on flat templates with little gradient.
